mpt_rec.license: No LICENSE file found in the existing local source repository; existing project code reused under user authorization.
adaptations: Extract only six baseline classes and torch imports.
Replace squeeze() with squeeze(-1) to preserve batch dimension for singleton batches; non-singleton numerical equivalence is tested.
AdaTT-sp extraction: two tasks, one native expert per task per layer, two layers with single-layer expert widths spec.hidden, ReLU and native-expert residual enabled.
Input embeddings are expanded to two task inputs, following upstream CentralTaskArch.forward.
Task sigmoid towers reuse existing MPT-Rec MLP; no extraction dropout.

regularization.embedding: .006 / (sum(vocab sizes) * embedding size), multiplied by half squared embedding weights
regularization.dnn: 3e-5 multiplied by half squared expert and tower Linear weights
regularization.excluded: Linear biases and gating parameters, following existing MPT-Rec MMOE/CGC conventions

architecture.sharedbottom: Existing SharedBottom: spec.hidden backbone, spec.tower towers
architecture.mmoe: Existing MMOE: three experts, spec.hidden experts, spec.tower towers
architecture.ple: Existing CGC/PLE equations assembled with one expert per task and one shared expert; hidden[0] and hidden[1] widths across two levels; spec.tower towers
architecture.aliccp_dropout: Existing [0.1, 0.3] SharedBottom/MMOE hidden dropout; PLE levels use 0.1 and 0.3; no tower dropout
